verdict.rationale: Rootly documents running the full incident lifecycle from Slack and Microsoft Teams, including channel creation (two-way chat-ops). Its workflow engine includes Jira actions and automatic ticket filing, and the AI connector can look up related Jira issues. However, the pack never names Zoom or GitHub integrations, and true bidirectional state sync with Jira is not shown. Missing for 10: documented Zoom integration, documented GitHub integration, explicit two-way Jira status sync, independent hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
